message.content: The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) via I‑5 S. Under normal conditions—straight through, no major detours or heavy traffic—you’d expect it to take about **6 to 7 hours**. In peak traffic periods (especially around the Bay Area and near the LA metro area) it can stretch to 8–9 hours, while a clear day might let you get there in just under 6 hours.
